subject: Vendor onboarding: payment handoff, wire fallback, and remit header requirements
messages:
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vervetec.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding: payment handoff, wire fallback, and remit header requirements

Hi Liam —

Welcome — happy to have Vervetec kick off with Redwood. Quick checklist to get your payments flowing cleanly once we start sending POs:

1) Banking proof: please send a bank letter / voided check (PDF) that matches the company name on your W-9 — we referenced the bank letter you attached (thank you).
2) Onboarding form: fill the attached onboarding XLS with exact remit address + ACH routing or wire instructions and the preferred invoice remittance header we should expect (sample below).
3) PO encoding: when we send a PO the golden path for invoice matching is: include the Redwood PO number in the invoice header and at least one of (a) invoice number, (b) invoice date, (c) line-level cost center code.

Remittance header example (required on each invoice):
- Remit-To: Vervetec Finance / Account 987654321
- PO#: RW-56789
- Invoice Ref: INV-####

If you prefer wire as primary, we will accept wires but need an ACH fallback (micro-deposit) so Finance can reconcile in the event of rail issues. Typical onboarding flow we use:
- Vendor submits bank letter + onboarding form (attached)
- Redwood runs ACH micro-deposit test (same-day or next business)
- Once micro-deposit verified we attach payment route to the vendor record and include remit header rules in the PO metadata

Can you confirm ETA for the completed onboarding form and whether wire or ACH will be the preferred path? Also, please confirm the remit-to exact phrasing you want on invoices so we map it into our AP parser.

Thanks —

Logan Wright
Partner Ops (Vendor Payments)
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: vervetec_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
Attachment: vervetec_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel)

From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vervetec.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: payments@vervetec.com
Date: Fri, 21 May 2026 17:42:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment handoff, wire fallback, and remit header requirements

Logan —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attached bank letter and the partially completed onboarding form (we left the PO sample field blank and flagged a question on invoice header). Answers inline below: 

- Preferred rail: Wire is preferred for our treasury team, but we can accept ACH for US invoices. We will provide ACH routing and account for fallback.
- Micro-deposit: fine — please advise the amount range you send for the test and the account name you will expect.
- Remit phrasing: please use exactly the following on any inbound invoice so our AR system auto-accepts it:
  "Vervetec Inc. / Remit: acct 987-654-321 / TaxID: 12-3456789"

We attached the bank letter (signed) and the onboarding form with bank info filled. We redacted internal GL mappings.

QUESTIONS:
- Does Redwood require invoices to include a PO on the first page only, or should the PO be repeated in the invoice body line items?

I'll follow up tomorrow with the procurement contact who will send the signed vendor agreement (DocuSign).

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Finance Operations
Vervetec Inc.
--
Attachment: vervetec_bank_letter.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
Attachment: vervetec_onboarding_form.xlsx (Excel)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@vervetec.com>, Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2026 09:05:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding: payment handoff, wire fallback, and remit header requirements

Hi Liam — thanks for the fast turnaround and for attaching the bank letter. Two quick operational notes from AP/Procurement so your invoices clear automatically: 

- PO placement: please include the Redwood PO number on the invoice header AND again on the first line of the invoice body. That redundancy helps our parser and prevents manual holds.
- Invoice metadata / tagging: we require one structured field named "Remit-Header" on the invoice PDF metadata or in the invoice PDF text exactly as you specified. Example we will match on: 
  Remit-Header: Vervetec Inc. / Remit: acct 987-654-321 / TaxID: 12-3456789

If you send the invoice via AP portal (preferred), you'll see a field for Remit-Header; if you email it, put the Remit-Header line at top of the PDF.

Micro-deposit details: Redwood sends two micro-deposits (random cents) to verify account ownership. Amounts are typically between $0.05 and $0.75. We will send from 'Redwood Payments', note will contain 'RW-verify' and a timestamp. Please confirm you will monitor the account for two entries and reply with the amounts to payments@redwood.ai to complete verification.

Finally — we will create a payment routing entry tagged to PO prefix RW- and add Vervetec's remit header as an exact match rule. That will speed payments once invoices are approved.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Payments Specialist
Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: AP_onboarding_instructions.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)
